Guangzhou Aspire Refrigeration Equipment.evidence: The company is documented as established in 2012 in Guangzhou, China, according to manufacturing directories. Product listings on industrial B2B portals show it manufactures and supplies desktop and upright soft-serve ice cream machines.

Shams Industrial Group.evidence: A company named Shams Industrial Group (or Shams Group) exists as an industrial trading and procurement supplier based in Tehran, Iran, but it does not manufacture or sell soft-serve ice cream machines. Soft-serve machines are instead produced by an entirely separate Iranian entity named Shams Company (shamscompany.com).
